findings.summary: R1 is covered by AT1 and milestones M1/M2, but M2 does not deliver any R1 functionality—M2 focuses on tags (R11-R13). R1 is fully delivered in M1 only.

evidence.quote: The system MUST accept a user-specified local directory path as input and recursively discover Markdown files

evidence.note: M1 delivers DL2: recursive .md file discovery
evidence.quote: Recursive .md file discovery from input directory (R1)

evidence.note: M2 deliverables are tag-focused (DL8-DL12), no R1 functionality
evidence.quote: Tag Extraction, Tag Pages, and Tag Navigation

findings.summary: R2 is covered by AT2 and milestones M1/M2, but M2 does not deliver any R2 functionality—M2 focuses on tags. R2 is fully delivered in M1 only.

evidence.quote: The system MUST generate a static build output consisting only of HTML, CSS, JavaScript

evidence.note: M1 delivers DL4: static HTML output
evidence.quote: One HTML page per input Markdown file written to output directory (R2, R3)

evidence.note: M2 deliverables are tag-focused, no R2 functionality
evidence.quote: Tag Extraction, Tag Pages, and Tag Navigation

findings.summary: R3 is covered by AT3 and milestones M1/M2, but M2 does not deliver any R3 functionality—M2 focuses on tags. R3 is fully delivered in M1 only.

evidence.note: R3 requires one HTML page per Markdown file
